note: First version: the text in one colour (a time in the accent, an error line, a hue's heading) that layouts wrap in a Box of their own

component.doc: A text in one colour, with no padding of its own: an event's time in the accent, a warning line in the error colour, a heading in a section's hue, a status headline in success. Secondary text by default; weight and max_lines are left out while empty. For the muted colour use core:muted_text, and for a small capitals label over a heading core:eyebrow.

params.name: color
params.doc: Its colour, a theme token such as ${local://theme#accent} or ${local://theme#error}.

params.name: style
params.doc: A core://Text style (Caption for a small detail, Label for a heading, Title for a headline).

params.name: weight
params.doc: A core://Text weight (SemiBold, Bold); empty for the style's own.

params.name: max_lines
params.doc: The most lines it takes; 0 for no limit.
